16.text: presence by the people of Mariinsky Post, who have great

17.text: faith in its effectiveness. Still another incantation requires

27.text: The Russianized natives of the Kolyma and Anadyr, in order to repress

28.text: the wind, “catch” it in a big overcoat spread windward, and then speedily tie

29.text: up the garment. The wind “tied up” may be quiet for twenty-four hours,

30.text: but after that time it must be let loose. If it should be kept captive longer

31.text: than that, it would, when finally freed, become a severe and prolonged storm.

32.text: This method of subduing the wind is known also to the Chukchee.
